async function run(items) {
 for (const item of await load()) { print(item); }
 for (const group of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  for (const item of await load(group)) { print(item); }
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  const label = (() => { return item.id; })();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await read(label);
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await read(item);
 }
}
